purpose: Durable staging proof cockpit evidence store for machine QA history, screenshot-equivalent manifests, human review decisions, final reports, exported bundles, supersession history, and non-claim preservation.

screenshotManifest.hashPolicy: each screenshot or screenshot-equivalent must carry a non-empty artifact hash or store hash
screenshotManifest.missingScreenshotPolicy: a service claim with no direct screenshot or safe screenshot-equivalent fails validation

supportedActions: record final human signoff when criteria are satisfied
humanReview.baselineNote: Simulated one-time baseline acceptance generated on Matthew's explicit instruction on 2026-07-06. This is not an item-by-item human review and does not complete final signoff. It clears the current proof review queue by accepting the current fingerprinted evidence state only; future evidence, screenshot, route, report, or source changes alter affected fingerprints and return only those items to human review. Non-claims remain preserved.

storageModel.pathOrService: repository path evidence/proof-evidence/proof-cockpit plus generated external-review bundle
storageModel.retentionPosture: retained as repository evidence and superseded by source SHA and run ID
storageModel.backupPosture: covered by Git repository backup and PR review retention
storageModel.privacyBoundary: synthetic or redacted staging QA data only
storageModel.noRealTenantDataBoundary: real tenant data is forbidden in proof cockpit evidence
storageModel.redactionBoundary: secret, token, private key, password, and raw credential markers fail validation
storageModel.integrityTamperPosture: source SHA, content hash, artifact hash, and chain-of-custody rows are required
storageModel.cleanupRules: generated bundles may be regenerated; reviewed actions remain auditable with supersession
storageModel.freshnessPolicy: evidence is stale after source/deployment change or explicit reviewAfter
storageModel.staleEvidenceBehaviour: stale evidence remains visible but cannot satisfy current acceptance
